lines: d38: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Valentina Hoffmann is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d38: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d38: 🕯️ Valentina Hoffmann is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d38: What Valentina kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d38: "Valentina's gone." Marcus looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Valentina." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d38: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lillian blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d38: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d38: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Valentina Hoffmann, 38 days. The mantle passes to Lillian Bose.
d38: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lillian Bose, 41 — a fishing guide. Their hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Lucky Rock, Echo Location, Trophy Room.
d38: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d38: The village's quarrel was with Valentina — and Valentina is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d38: At the grave, Jaxon, Javier, Jesse and 3 more speak for Lillian — "Valentina trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d38: The fire knew Lillian before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d38: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d38: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Night Hunting (Level 1). Hunting at night is not hunting blind. It is hunting by ear, by smell, by patience.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d38: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
